_comment: spi_tmc switches the bridge's SPI hook to a TMC register file. Each 5-byte datagram is decoded; writes are stored, reads return the stored value. Klippy's tmc.write_register / tmc.read_register verify pattern (write a value, read it back, compare) passes because we echo the write. Per-CS chip selection is not modeled - the register file is shared - which is fine because klippy initializes each TMC chip sequentially (write all of A's regs, then read; then move to B). analog_in_default stages the heater thermistor ADC (EPCOS 100K on PK5, 4700 pullup): without it the unset ADC reads 0 and the firmware shuts down with 'ADC out of range' before the DUMP_TMC reads run. 5000 maps inside the configured 0..250 C range.
